title: signs you're an overthinker
slides: you rewrite a text five times, then send "ok"
you replay conversations from three days ago
"we need to talk" ruins your entire week
you plan responses to arguments that will never happen
a slow reply feels like a verdict on you
caption: which one is the most you? 🫠 send this to your fellow overthinker

title: things that are not your job
slides: managing everyone else's mood
being available 24/7
explaining your boundaries over and over
fixing people who don't want to change
being "easy" so others feel comfortable
caption: read that again. you're allowed to put some of it down ♡

title: small things that are actually self care
slides: changing your sheets on a sunday
drinking water before coffee
replying "can we talk tomorrow?" instead of forcing it tonight
going to bed without one last scroll
eating an actual meal, not just snacks
caption: self care doesn't have to be a spa day. save this for later ♡

title: what to do when your mind won't stop
slides: write the thought down. it's quieter on paper
ask: is this a fact or a feeling?
name 5 things you can see right now
breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4
tell the worry "not now, tomorrow at 6"
caption: save this for the next 2am spiral 🌙

title: after a breakup, remember
slides: missing them doesn't mean you should go back
you don't need closure from them to heal
checking their profile reopens the wound
a bad day doesn't send you back to day one
you are allowed to outgrow people you loved
caption: for whoever needed this today ♡ send it to them

title: green flags in a friend
slides: they remember the tiny things you mentioned once
you don't have to perform around them
they're happy for you without making it about them
silence with them never feels awkward
they check on you when you go quiet
caption: tag the friend who's all of these ♡

title: a gentle sunday reset
slides: clear one surface. just one
write down everything in your head
pick 3 priorities for the week, not 12
plan one thing you're looking forward to
go to bed 30 minutes earlier
caption: your monday self will thank you ♡ save this

title: thinking traps your brain loves
slides: mind reading: "they think i'm annoying"
catastrophizing: "this will ruin everything"
all or nothing: "not perfect = failure"
personalizing: "they're quiet, it must be me"
fortune telling: "i just know it'll go badly"
caption: naming the trap is half the battle. which one do you fall into most?

title: you're healing if
slides: you can hear their name without your stomach dropping
you stopped explaining yourself to people who don't listen
you rest without feeling guilty
you notice red flags sooner
you choose peace over being right
caption: it's slow, but it's happening ♡

title: permission slips you needed
slides: you're allowed to leave the party early
you're allowed to change your mind
you're allowed to not reply right away
you're allowed to start over at any age
you're allowed to take up space
caption: consider this your permission ♡ save it

title: texts that are actually love
slides: "did you get home safe?"
"this made me think of you"
"no pressure to reply"
"how did the thing go?"
"i'm proud of you"
caption: send one of these to someone today ♡

title: how to quiet the 3am thoughts
slides: keep a notebook by your bed, not your phone
write "i'll deal with this tomorrow" and mean it
remember: night makes everything look darker
focus on your breathing, slower on the exhale
nothing important gets decided at 3am
caption: for the night owls who don't want to be ♡
